versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the email-outreach skill: an automated campaign builder and optimizer for sales and cold email outreach.
- Generates ready-to-send cold emails, multi-touch outreach sequences, and follow-up cadences based on campaign and target details.
- Offers scalable personalization using merge fields and custom first line variants.
- Provides multiple subject line options for each email to improve open rates.
- Audits email copy for deliverability issues and suggests A/B test variants.
- Outputs campaigns in a clear, ready-to-copy format with personalization notes and workflow guidance.
